source:
@@U03419@@
Disgusting sight!
Hideous!

@@U03421@@
Serves you right!
It’s what you deserve!

@@U03423@@
That clever little number
is one I'd like to snatch—
but as soon as | grab,
a lizard slithers from my hand,
her braid slick as a snake!
Ah! Then that one there,
tall and slender!
And what do I have but a bacchic wand
with a pinecone at its tip!
Where does this end?
Aha, this fat one, then,
for a bit of a revel,
but this the last! Here goes!
Ah, all squishy-squiggly!
Orientals, I’ve heard, pay in gold for this!
Oh, but the puffball bursts in two!
Phew!

@@U03425@@
Separate!
Flit round him,
this son of a witch!
Like lightning, like darkness,
swaying, hovering,
black bat wings pounding in
fearsome circles!
Let him not get off so lightly!
translation:
@@U03419@@
恶心的景象！
可怕！

@@U03421@@
为您服务就对了！
这是你应得的！

@@U03423@@
那个聪明的小数字
是我想抢走的——
但只要 |抓住，
一只蜥蜴从我手中滑落，
她的辫子像蛇一样光滑！
啊!然后那边的那个，
又高又瘦！
除了一根狂欢魔杖我还有什么
尖端有一个松果！
这到哪里结束呢？
啊哈，那么这个胖子，
为了一点狂欢，
但这是最后一次了！开始吧！
啊，全都是软软的！
我听说东方人为此支付黄金！
哦，但是马勃裂成了两半！
唷！

@@U03425@@
分开！
绕着他飞来飞去，
这个巫婆的儿子！
如同闪电，如同黑暗，
摇摆、盘旋、
黑色蝙蝠翅膀扑通扑通
可怕的圆圈！
让他不要这么轻易下车！
